# nx-repro-build reproducibility exceptions (framework V3, front V3-REPRO-01)
#
# One relative output path per line (relative to the per-worktree output root,
# e.g. "aarch64/nxexample-aarch64/GENERATION.json").  Blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored.
#
# An entry here means: this exact generated file is ALLOWED to differ between
# the two clean-worktree builds.  Every entry MUST carry, in a comment right
# above it, (1) a written justification of WHY the divergence is inherent and
# (2) how semantic equivalence of the divergent copies was verified.  An empty
# file is the expected healthy state: the generator is byte-reproducible and
# nothing is excused.
